Class NoOpStore

java.lang.Object
ci.storage.NoOpStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
Storage
public class NoOpStore extends Object implements Storage
No-op implementation of build storage.

This implementation does not persist any build data. It is used as a placeholder for tests that don't need real storage.
